question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A place for storage of arms and ammunition
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Arsenal"** means a place where weapons and military equipment are stored or made. (हथियारों का भंडार)

 
 
• **Example:** The military base has a large **arsenal **to supply the troops during a conflict.
 
 
 
• **"Mint"** refers to a place where coins, medals, or tokens are manufactured. (सिक्के बनाने की जगह)
 
 
• **Example:** The Royal** Mint **produces all the coins for the United Kingdom.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the one-word substitute for "A place for storage of arms and ammunition" is **'Arsenal'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mint** (सिक्के बनाने की जगह): A place where coins, medals, or tokens are manufactured.

 
 
• **Example:** The Royal **Mint **produces all the coins for the United Kingdom.
 
 
 
• **Monastery** (मठ): A building or buildings occupied by a community of monks living under religious vows.
 
 
• **Example:** The monks live a simple life in the **monastery.**
 
 
 
• **Scullery** (बर्तन धोने का कमरा): A small kitchen or room at the back of a house used for washing dishes and other dirty household work.
 
 
• **Example:** She spent the morning cleaning the **scullery.**
